[[File:Ash_Angels.png|thumb|right|200px|The Ash Angels]]
The '''Ash Angels''' were an elite [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] that was composed entirely of [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The Ash Angels went rogue during the tenuous peace with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and began launching raids against Imperial forces near their Imperial-occupied [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] until the [[Battle of Sululluub|Empire wiped them out]] in the [[Sululluub]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]].
